definitions.gloss: vested rights; vested interests; established privileges
definitions.explanation: Rights or advantages that a person or group already holds and is unwilling to give up. In news and politics it usually carries criticism: privileges that block reform.

examples.japanese: {既得権|きとくけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧。
⟦{改革|かいかく}→改革：04815_kaikaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{業界|ぎょうかい}→業界：13129_gyoukai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{既得権|きとくけん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦ぶつかった→ぶつかる：02412_butsukaru⟧。
examples.english: The reform ran up against the industry's established privileges.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{市場|しじょう}→市場：09685_shijou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}れない→入る：00494_hairu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{既得権益|きとくけんえき}→既得権益：22634_kitokukeneki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧⟦{団体|だんたい}→団体：03426_dantai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{反対|はんたい}している→反対する：05648_hantaisuru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧だ。
examples.english: New companies can't enter the market because groups with vested interests are opposing it.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {既得権|きとくけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧: to protect vested interests
- {既得権|きとくけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{手放|てばな}す→手放す：05338_tebanasu⟧: to give up established privileges
- ⟦{既得権益|きとくけんえき}→既得権益：22634_kitokukeneki⟧: vested interests, the commoner form in news writing
